You must have heard the rumors about my research. Yes! But since you probably know already, I'll tell you without hiding, I mean, there's nothing to hide.
scripts.translation: 你一定聽說過我的研究傳聞了。沒錯！不過你大概已經知道了，所以我就不隱瞞了，反正也沒什麼好隱瞞的。

scripts.text: Actually, you can say my research is complete! Nothing's impossible for my genius! Bwahaha, it's just a matter of time!
scripts.translation: 其實，你可以說我的研究已經完成了！天才的我無所不能！哇哈哈，這只是時間問題！

scripts.text: Are you still here? Right, you wanted to know about my research. It's actually very simple. I was just trying to invent a super liquid that can melt everything!
scripts.translation: 你還在這裡啊？對了，你想了解我的研究。其實很簡單，我只是在嘗試發明一種能融化一切的超級液體！

scripts.text: Isn't it interesting? No matter how strong you are, you can't break apart stone or steel, but with my new liquid, you can melt those things, making them soft like puddy!
scripts.translation: 這不是很有趣嗎？無論你多強，都無法徒手弄碎石頭或鋼鐵；但用我的新液體就能融化它們，讓它們變得像油灰一樣柔軟！

scripts.text: It can't melt everything yet, but I did find that you could combine things that you could never mix before with my invention. Heeheeheehee~!
scripts.translation: 雖然它還不能融化一切，但我發現用這項發明可以把以前無法混合的東西結合起來。嘿嘿嘿嘿～！

scripts.text: You can make a whole lot of things that you'd never would have imagined possible! I can make you a lot of new things you never would have imagined using this method... as long as you want it!!
scripts.translation: 用這種方法，可以做出許多你從未想過的東西！只要你想要，我就能幫你做出各種新玩意兒！！

scripts.text: The endorphins are rushing to my face at least 2.1 times faster than the usual rate! Ah! I'm so excited! I... I just can't hide it!
scripts.translation: 內啡肽湧上臉頰的速度至少比平常快2.1倍！啊！我太興奮了！我...我簡直藏不住這份激動！

scripts.text: You want me to make something totally new, huh? Hehhehheh! I love your sense of scientific adventure!
scripts.translation: 你想讓我做點全新的東西，是吧？嘿嘿嘿！我喜歡你這種科學冒險精神！

scripts.text: You want to make a Counteragent? Hohohohoho, let's see what we'll need...
scripts.translation: 你想製作對抗劑嗎？呵呵呵呵呵，讓我看看需要什麼...

scripts.text: Oh, I remember, yes, Alcohol, and um, er, Detrimindexta and an Empty Bottle to put it it all in. Just these three items and 3000 zeny.
scripts.translation: 啊，我想起來了，沒錯，需要酒精，還有...嗯...帝特立米藥水，以及用來裝它們的空瓶。就這三樣，再加上3000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Oh, I just can't wait to make this! Are you ready to begin?
scripts.translation: 啊，我等不及要做這個了！準備好開始了嗎？

scripts.text: Heuheuheuheuh.... not enough... not enough.. Haah...Haah... Go..... get the rest of the materials!
scripts.translation: 嗚嘿嘿嘿...不夠...還不夠...哈啊...哈啊...去...把剩下的材料找來！

scripts.text: We'll postpone the fun until then... Heuheuheuheuheuh.
scripts.translation: 那就把樂趣留到之後吧...嗚嘿嘿嘿嘿。
